# counter - a number with a minus and a plus button

```js
import { counter } from './counter.js'

counter({ start: 5 })
```

| Prop    | Values | Default | Notes              |
| ------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------ |
| `start` | number | `0`     | The value at mount |

The count lives in the `demo.count` state, see [state](state.md).
